meta.purpose: Certification and continuous learning tracker — eligibility, prerequisites, cost band, duration, curriculum, practical value and the official registration page for each opportunity.

verification.rule: Fees, dates, eligibility and syllabus change without notice. Every entry carries verifyBeforeUse: true. Confirm on the official page before you pay, register or plan around a course.

costBands.free-audit: Free to study or audit; certificate or assessment may be paid
costBands.variable: Depends on pathway, region or partner

verification.disclaimer: No certification here is a guaranteed job qualification. Value depends on the employer, the role and what you can actually demonstrate.

entries.name: CMA Final (ICMAI)
entries.eligibility: After clearing CMA Intermediate, with the prescribed practical training and subject to ICMAI registration rules.
entries.costNote: Registration, exam and training fees are set by ICMAI and revised periodically — check the current fee notification.
curriculum: Direct Tax Laws and International Taxation
entries.practicalValue: The core credential for the management accounting career path in India and the mandatory next step after Intermediate.
entries.plan: After Intermediate Group II (target June 2027)

entries.name: ICMAI practical training and programmes
entries.eligibility: Registered ICMAI students, subject to the stage-specific requirements.
entries.costNote: Varies by programme; some student programmes are free or nominally priced. Verify on the ICMAI student portal.
entries.duration: Varies — modular programmes and prescribed training periods
entries.practicalValue: Satisfies the practical training requirement and provides the earliest exposure to professional practice.
entries.plan: Check eligibility during Intermediate Group II

entries.name: Microsoft Learn pathways (Excel, Power BI, Azure AI)
entries.eligibility: Open to anyone with a free Microsoft account.
entries.costNote: Learning paths, modules and documentation are free. Certification exams are paid separately.
entries.practicalValue: Free, structured and directly aligned with the software academy. Best used as the theory spine while you build your own projects.
entries.plan: Use alongside skill-excel and skill-power-bi

entries.name: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
entries.eligibility: No formal prerequisite; recommended experience building reports and models.
entries.costNote: Exam fee is region-specific and changes; verify the current price on the Microsoft certification page. Student discounts are sometimes available.
entries.practicalValue: Recognised by employers who run Microsoft analytics stacks. Worth taking only after you can already build a dashboard unaided.
entries.plan: After skill-power-bi and two portfolio dashboards

entries.name: SAP Learning Journeys (FI/CO)
entries.eligibility: Open registration on SAP Learning.
entries.costNote: Learning journeys are free. System access and certification exams usually involve cost or an employer environment.
curriculum: Procure to pay and order to cash
entries.practicalValue: Functional ERP literacy that most Indian cost accounting roles expect. Certification is optional until an employer requires it.
entries.plan: After Intermediate, if targeting an ERP-heavy role

entries.name: Oracle University financials learning
entries.eligibility: Open registration.
entries.costNote: Some content is free; certification and training subscriptions are paid. Verify current offerings.
entries.practicalValue: Useful if you target a group that runs Oracle. Lower priority than gaining actual ERP exposure.
entries.plan: Opportunistic only

entries.name: Google data analytics and AI courses
entries.eligibility: Open to anyone.
entries.costNote: Many Google courses are free to audit; the professional certificate involves a subscription. Verify on the provider page.
entries.practicalValue: Good structured introduction with a recognised name. Supplement with finance-specific projects, since these courses are not finance-oriented.
entries.plan: Optional, after SQL fundamentals

entries.name: IBM SkillsBuild (AI, data, professional skills)
entries.eligibility: Open registration.
entries.costNote: Free digital credentials through SkillsBuild.
entries.practicalValue: Genuinely free credentials with a credible name for AI literacy. Useful as structured evidence of self-directed learning.
entries.plan: During the AI foundations phase

entries.name: Coursera specialisations (finance, analytics)
entries.eligibility: Open registration; financial aid available in many regions.
entries.costNote: Most courses can be audited free. Certificates need a subscription or one-off fee. Financial aid application is worth attempting.
entries.practicalValue: Wide choice, uneven quality. Choose courses from universities or firms with a strong finance reputation and finish one before starting another.
entries.plan: One specialisation per quarter during professional development phase

entries.name: edX courses and MicroMasters
entries.eligibility: Open registration; verification fees apply for certificates.
entries.costNote: Audit free on most courses; verified certificates and MicroMasters are paid. Financial assistance is available.
entries.duration: 4–12 weeks per course; longer for programmes
entries.practicalValue: Stronger academic depth than many alternatives. Useful where you want a rigorous treatment of a technical topic.
entries.plan: For depth on statistics or finance theory

entries.name: Infosys Springboard
entries.eligibility: Open registration for learners; some programmes target students and institutions.
entries.costNote: Free learning content and certifications on the platform.
entries.practicalValue: Underused free resource in India with structured certification. Good for building technical foundations without cost.
entries.plan: Use for Python and AI foundations

entries.name: Financial modelling certificates (various providers)
entries.eligibility: Usually open; some require finance experience for advanced tracks.
entries.costNote: Fees vary widely and are frequently discounted. Compare syllabus and sample outputs before paying — a portfolio model may serve you better than a certificate.
entries.practicalValue: Useful structure and templates, but employers assess the model you can build, not the certificate. Complete the FP&A projects in this repository first.
entries.plan: Only after three portfolio models are complete

entries.name: CFA Program
entries.eligibility: Degree or equivalent work experience; enrolment windows and fees apply.
prerequisites: Significant study time (hundreds of hours per level)
entries.costNote: Enrolment and exam fees are substantial and region-dependent; scholarships exist. Verify current fees.
entries.practicalValue: Strong for investment and portfolio roles. Not necessary for cost accounting or FP&A paths; do not let it compete with the CMA exam.
entries.plan: Consider only after CMA Final, if pursuing markets

entries.name: CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants)
entries.eligibility: Open entry with exemptions based on prior qualifications; ICMAI holders may get subject exemptions — verify with CIMA.
entries.costNote: Subscription, exam and exemption fees; regional pricing applies. Verify.
entries.practicalValue: Internationally portable management accounting credential. Useful only if you intend to work outside India; high overlap with CMA content.
entries.plan: Not recommended before CMA Final

entries.name: ACCA
entries.eligibility: Open entry with exemptions for recognised qualifications.
entries.costNote: Per-exam and annual fees; exemption fees apply. Verify current pricing.
entries.practicalValue: Strong for reporting and audit careers, especially internationally. Substantial overlap with CMA at the fundamentals level.
entries.plan: Not recommended in parallel with CMA

entries.name: Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
entries.eligibility: Degree plus relevant experience; three-part exam.
prerequisites: Internal audit or accounting experience recommended
entries.costNote: Application, exam part and membership fees; verify current pricing.
entries.practicalValue: The recognised credential for internal audit roles. High value if you target audit rather than core FP&A.
entries.plan: Optional after CMA Final, if targeting audit

entries.name: IIA India training and certification support
entries.eligibility: Members and students; varies by programme.
prerequisites: Membership usually required for member pricing
entries.costNote: Membership and event fees vary — verify with IIA India.
entries.practicalValue: Local training and networking at low cost, useful if you are building an audit specialisation.
entries.plan: Opportunistic

entries.name: NISM certifications (securities markets)
entries.eligibility: Open registration; some certifications require sponsorship by a registered intermediary.
entries.costNote: Modest examination fees set by NISM. Verify on the NISM portal.
entries.practicalValue: The regulated, India-specific route for markets knowledge. Relevant only if you are pursuing a markets or advisory role.
entries.plan: Only if pursuing the markets module seriously

entries.name: Python Institute PCEP / PCAP
entries.eligibility: Open registration.
entries.costNote: Exam vouchers are modestly priced; free study resources exist. Verify.
entries.practicalValue: A cheap, vendor-neutral proof of Python fundamentals. Optional — your projects demonstrate more than the certificate.
entries.plan: Optional, after the Python beginner level

entries.name: AWS Cloud Practitioner / AI Practitioner
entries.eligibility: Open registration.
entries.costNote: Foundational exam fees are modest; free digital training available. Verify.
entries.practicalValue: Useful only if your finance role touches cloud platforms or analytics infrastructure. Lower priority than Power BI and SQL.
entries.plan: Deferred

entries.name: ICAI certificate courses (GST, Ind AS, forensic)
entries.eligibility: Members and students of ICAI; some courses open to others.
prerequisites: Membership or student registration for member rates
entries.costNote: Certificate course fees are usually modest; verify on ICAI.
entries.duration: A few days to a few weeks
entries.practicalValue: Focused, inexpensive, and taught by practitioners. Strong option for GST and Ind AS depth alongside CMA.
entries.plan: GST and Ind AS courses during Final preparation

entries.name: NPTEL / SWAYAM courses
entries.eligibility: Open registration; exam centres for proctored certification.
entries.costNote: Learning is free; the optional proctored exam carries a modest fee. Verify.
entries.practicalValue: Excellent value for quantitative depth with an Indian academic credential. Strong for Paper 9 and Paper 16 quantitative topics.
entries.plan: Use for operations research and statistics depth

entries.name: SWAYAM finance and accounting courses
entries.eligibility: Open registration.
entries.costNote: Free to learn; optional certification exam fee applies.
entries.practicalValue: Free, government-backed and aligned to Indian syllabi. Useful supplementary revision at zero cost.
entries.plan: Supplementary revision

priorityOrder.reason: Directly required for the qualification and the career path.
Free, structured, and immediately useful for the software and quantitative skills.
Low cost, targeted depth once the foundation is built.
Employer-recognised, but only worth paying for when a target role requires it.
High cost or low marginal value for the current plan. Defer until the CMA qualification is complete and the career direction is clear.
